parameters.name: AccelerationType
parameters.description:
The acceleration mode:
- **whiltelist**: whitelist acceleration
- **global**: global acceleration
-  **build-in-list**: built-in system application acceleration

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the enterprise acceleration policy.

parameters.name: EapId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise acceleration policy.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the enterprise acceleration policy.

parameters.name: OnTls
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable TLS mode:
- **0**: disable
- **1**: enable

parameters.name: ShowInClient
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display on the client:
- **0**: do not display
- **1**: display

parameters.name: UpstreamHost
parameters.description: The address (IP or domain name) of the acceleration instance.

parameters.name: UpstreamPort
parameters.description: The port of the acceleration instance (between 1000 and 60000).
